== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed (PC Errata 2013 slip)]]. Compared with the printed card [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed]] (Decipher, June 1999): the lower part of the earlier card image (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
